Performing Arts Center Workshop

The Malibu Arts Commission will participate in a special workshop session, inviting the community to
explore the concept of a new Performing Arts Center at Cross Creek Ranch (formerly La Paz).
Community members can review the conceptual design, provide feedback, and learn about the
Community Lands Project.
